mapper.update: UPDATE flow_busi_info SET `callback_num` = `callback_num` + 1 , bus_status=#{busStatus}, bus_return_msg=#{message}, update_time=#{updateTime}, update_by=#{userId} WHERE (process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId})
mapper.select: SELECT t.`values`,t1.bus_name as values_name FROM flow_busi_info t left join flow_busi_config t1 on t.process_key = t1.process_key where t.process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId}
